faq: Is the theme included in the price?
Free themes are included. If a paid theme fits better, we tell you its license price first, and you buy it in your own name so the license is yours.
Will my store look just like the demo?
Close, but with your own logo, colors and photos. Demo stores use stock images, so the final look depends on your product pictures, which we help you prepare.
Can I choose my own theme?
Yes. Send a link and we check that it is fast, kept up to date and works well with WooCommerce. If not, we explain why and suggest alternatives.
What if I need bigger changes later?
Small edits you can do in the editor. For bigger changes, our theme edits service works in a child theme, so theme updates do not undo anything.

desc:
Ecom Swift LLC provides ready-made WooCommerce theme setup: we choose a fast, editor-friendly store theme, install it and fill it with your branding and products, so you can open sooner and edit pages yourself.

## What is a ready-made WooCommerce theme setup?

A ready-made WooCommerce theme setup uses an existing, proven store theme as the starting point instead of a custom design. We select the theme with you, install it and replace the demo content with your logo, colors, photos and text. The result is a working shop built on a layout that thousands of stores already rely on, which keeps the project simple and quick.

## Why starting from a proven theme makes sense

A custom design is not always necessary. For many new shops, a good theme already offers a suitable home page, product page, cart and shop layout. Starting from one saves time because the hard layout decisions are made, and it lowers risk because the theme has been used and tested by many stores.

The difficulty is in choosing and setting it up well. A theme loaded with features can be slow, and a demo import can leave behind sample pages, placeholder images and settings that do not suit your products. Done carefully, setup keeps only what you need.

## How a good theme choice affects the shop

A theme sets the rhythm of the whole store: how products are shown, how filters work and how the phone layout behaves. If the theme is lightweight and well coded, pages load faster, and shoppers move from category to product to cart with less effort. If it is overloaded, it works against you on every page.

Using the block editor means you can change text, images and sections without code, so updates do not wait for a developer. That keeps prices, banners and seasonal messages current. How the store performs commercially still depends on your products, prices and audience, and the theme only provides a sound base.

## What a complete theme setup includes

- A theme chosen with you for your products, speed and ease of editing.
- Logo, colors and fonts applied consistently.
- The home page filled from the demo layout with your own content.
- Shop page and product page layout configured.
- Menus and footer arranged around your categories.
- Products added with photos, prices and variations as the package allows.
- About, contact and policy pages created from your information.
- Shop filters and sorting configured, and a payment gateway connected on larger packages.
- A short video showing you how to edit pages yourself.

## How we work

We begin by asking what you sell, who buys it and which stores you like. We suggest a theme, explain why it fits, and once you agree we install it on your WordPress site. We then replace the demo content with yours and remove anything left over.

We set up menus, the shop page and the product layout, add products from your files and check the result on a phone. The Basic package covers the theme choice, branding, home page and a first group of products. Standard adds more products, key pages, filters and a payment gateway, plus the editing video. Premium includes shipping and tax settings, light custom styling, image compression, caching and branded emails.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Pick a theme for how it handles your kind of products.
- Prepare clear photos in a consistent style.
- Learn the basics of the block editor from the video.
- Keep the theme and extensions updated.

**Avoid:**
- Importing the full demo and leaving sample content live.
- Choosing a theme because of one flashy feature.
- Adding plugins to copy features the theme already has.
- Expecting the store to match the demo photo for photo.

## Who this is for

This service suits a first-time seller who wants to open quickly with a clean look, a small business with a modest catalog that does not need custom design, and an owner who wants to manage pages without a developer. It also suits a founder testing a product idea before investing in a larger build.

## What we need from you

Send your logo, brand colors, product photos and details, and a few examples of stores you like. We need an administrator user in your WordPress site, never your password. If you already own a theme, tell us. If not, we advise on one, and any theme license is bought by you directly from its maker.
